coverage_gaps: Production deployment and production data are prohibited and intentionally unobserved
Unlisted browser engines and production topology remain release-stage verification concerns
Architecture-module tests and historical ledgers require separate governance tasks

conclusion: No data-migration P0-P3 deviation was observed; external repository failures are reproducible but outside the approved REQ-031 controlled plant.
